item.title: Rallying Cry – June 12, 2026
item.description: South Korea kicked off the World Cup with a thrilling 2-1 win over Czechia, while BTS-mania continues to fuel the country’s economy, and clever Peruvian police dressed as World Cup mascots to outsmart a suspected drug dealer—plus, scientists uncovered a mind-blowing fungal network that could stretch to the stars!
